lastCompletedStory.title: Surface the circuit-broken blocker in the orchestrator boot-read

nextStoryContext: US-004 (docs-only) added an escalated:true branch to the implement-blocked boot-read block in both templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md and .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, surfacing a distinct '⚠ implement circuit-broken: issue #<issueId> story <id> (<N> identical BLOCKED_...) — needs PRD amendment' line, keeping the existing non-escalated 'implement blocked' line unchanged. Discovered and fixed a pre-existing (not caused by this story) dual-copy drift: the whole CAM-195 implement-blocked boot-read section existed only in templates/, never synced to .claude/ -- restored it there to keep the mirror byte-identical (verified via plain diff) before running bun run embed-vendor. embed-vendor:check only diffs templates/ against src/vendor/_generated.ts, never templates/ against .claude/ directly, so this class of drift is NOT caught by the vendor-drift gate; a future story touching agent/command prompts should diff the two copies directly, not just trust embed-vendor:check. Added a doc-gate test in test/embedded.test.ts (CAM-190 pattern) asserting templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md'] contains 'circuit-broken', which raised the file's line count over its file-size-budget ceiling (645->653); raised only that ceiling with a dated _ref note. No runtime/marker-consuming code touched: this story is read-only surfacing, per AC2 the doc still instructs never to delete the marker.
